name: Boathouse Row
subtitle: Schuylkill River at Boathouse Row, above Fairmount Dam.

course.note: Estimate from the mapped river line upstream of the dock. Not checked on the water.

copy.description: Go, caution or stay off: rowing conditions on the Schuylkill River at Boathouse Row, Philadelphia, PA.
copy.flowStats: Since 2016 the median day is about 2,000 cfs. 5,700 is the top 12% of days, 9,000 the top 5%.
copy.flowHow: Flow is measured at the USGS gauge at Fairmount Dam, about 200 m below Boathouse Row. The forecast is from the NWS Middle Atlantic River Forecast Center for the same gauge, in 6-hour steps.
copy.credits: Forecast from [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/). Alerts and Philadelphia airport observations from the [National Weather Service, Mount Holly](https://www.weather.gov/phi/). River flow and water temperature from USGS gauge [01474500 at Philadelphia](https://waterdata.usgs.gov/monitoring-location/USGS-01474500/). River forecast from the [NWS Middle Atlantic River Forecast Center](https://water.noaa.gov/gauges/padp1). Air quality from Open-Meteo (Copernicus CAMS), and the model comparison from GFS, ECMWF, GEM and ICON via Open-Meteo.
